info.title: Insurance Evidence Protection Foundation
info.description: Extends the existing private document infrastructure. No claims submission/disclosure or insurance physical purge. Production scanner is unconfigured; new insurance uploads remain quarantined. Linking is disabled until documented activation gates pass. Patient/tenant ownership and dual clinical/insurance authorization are server-side. Existing clinical response shapes remain unchanged. New insurance uploads and links are disabled by default until the protected rollout is approved. Tenant-owned files require insurance_documents.tenant_view and tenant_upload in addition to ordinary insurance abilities.
